import re
from collections import Counter


def main(text: str):
    words = re.findall(r"[a-z']+", text.lower())
    top = Counter(w for w in words if len(w) > 4).most_common(5)
    return {
        "words": len(words),
        "characters": len(text),
        "sentences": len(re.findall(r"[.!?]+", text)),
        "top_words": [word for word, _ in top],
    }
